subject.title: WhatsApp channel: expose ctwa_clid from Click-to-WhatsApp ads in session metadata

question: Should WhatsApp CTWA attribution data be exposed only as per-turn untrusted structured context, exposed to plugin hooks for attribution plugins, or persisted as session metadata for later Conversions API use?
rationale: The extraction is technically bounded, but the requested value is an advertising click identifier and the issue asks for prompt/session exposure, so automation should not choose the visibility and retention boundary.

options.title: Per-Turn Untrusted Context
options.body: Extract `ctwaClid` and related ad fields in the WhatsApp plugin and expose them only through the existing fenced untrusted structured-context prompt path without durable persistence.

options.title: Plugin-Hook Attribution Payload
options.body: Define a typed WhatsApp attribution payload for opted-in plugin hooks so a Conversions API plugin can consume it without putting the identifier into every agent prompt.

options.title: Persist Session Attribution
options.body: Store the first CTWA payload on session state only with an explicit retention, redaction, and access policy.

recommendation.title: Per-Turn Untrusted Context
recommendation.body: Extract `ctwaClid` and related ad fields in the WhatsApp plugin and expose them only through the existing fenced untrusted structured-context prompt path without durable persistence.

likelyOwner.reason: He recently repaired the adjacent WhatsApp external-ad metadata path and the untrusted prompt boundary this decision would likely reuse.
